source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; VanderKam 1984 Enoch and the Growth of an Apocalyptic Tradition.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 33 — EASTERN GATES OF HEAVEN — **GREEK AKHMIM NOT PRESERVED (Akhmim breaks off in/near ch 32); Aramaic 4Q205/4Q206 only sparse fragments preserved.** Ge'ez is the PRIMARY witness for chs 33-36. Uriel as guide for the gates of heaven (cf. 20:2, 33:3-4). Tour of the four cardinal directions begins.

verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ውስተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወርእኩ፡ ህየ፡ አራዊተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ አሐደ፡ ለአሐዱ፡ ይትሌለዩ፡ ወአዕዋፍኒ፡ ይትሌለዩ፡ በራእይ፡ ወበሕብር፡ ወቃሎሙ፡ ካልእ፡ ለካልእ፡ ዘይትሌለይ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmhəya ḥorku wəsta ʾaṣnāfa mədr wa-rəʾku həya ʾarāwita ʿabayta ʾaḥada la-ʾaḥadu yətlēlayu wa-ʾaʿwāfni yətlēlayu ba-rāʾəy wa-ba-ḥəbər wa-qālomu kāləʾ la-kāləʾ za-yətlēlayu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1912; Knibb 1978) — primary witness; Akhmim Greek does not preserve chs 33-36
verses.notes: **WITNESS-ATTESTATION CHANGE — Ge'ez is now the PRIMARY witness.** From here through ch 36, the Akhmim Greek breaks off, and only sparse Aramaic 4Q205/4Q206 fragments are preserved. The Ge'ez tradition (Charles 1912 PD + Knibb 1978 critical edition) is the only complete witness. **Enoch arrives at the ends of the earth — sees great beasts each different in form, and birds different in appearance, voice, and color.** Cosmic-fauna inventory.

verses.text_geez: ወመንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ እማንቱ፡ አራዊት፡ ርእኩ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ኀበ፡ ይትዐርፍ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአናቅጸ፡ ሰማይ፡ ክሥቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-mangala ṣəbāḥ ʾəmāntu ʾarāwit rəʾku ʾaṣnāfa mədr ḫaba yətʿarrəf samāy wa-ʾanāqəḍa samāy kəśtu
verses.notes: **THE EASTERN GATES OF HEAVEN OPEN.** The 'gates of heaven' (አናቅጸ ሰማይ) is foundational astronomical-cosmology. Cross-corpus: Mesopotamian 'gates of sunrise' through which Shamash enters; Gen 28:17 ('gate of heaven'); Ps 78:23. The eastern gates of heaven control sunrise + star-rising. Picked up systematically in 1 En 72-82 (Book of Luminaries) — the 12 gates of east + west for the luminaries' annual circuit.

verses.text_geez: ወርእኩ፡ ከመ፡ ይወፅኡ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኆለቅዎሙ፡ ዑርኤል፡ ቅዱስ፡ መልአክ፡ ዘምስሌየ፡ ሀሎ፡ አርአየኒ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ወኵሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ወመዋዕሊሆሙ፡ ወሰዓታቲሆሙ፡ ወመንገሊሆሙ፡ ወሐሤሣቲሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-rəʾku kama yəwaḍḍəʾu ʾəmənnehomu kawākəbta samāy wa-ḫolaqəwwomu ʿUrʾēl qəddus malʾak za-məslēya hallo ʾarʾayanī kwəlu manbaromu la-kawākəbt wa-kwəlu səmātihomu wa-mawāʿəlihomu wa-saʿātātihomu wa-mangalihomu wa-ḥaśśēśātihomu
verses.notes: **Uriel shows Enoch ALL the names, places, times, hours, paths of the stars.** Cross-corpus: Ps 147:4 ('he counts the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names'); Isa 40:26. The stars-by-name tradition feeds astrological / angelological / Hermetic literature.

verses.text_geez: ወጸሐፈ፡ ሊተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ወዓመታቲሆሙ፡ ወመንግሥቶሙ፡ ወቦአ፡ ወአርአየኒ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ኪያሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-ṣaḥafa lita kwəlo səmātihomu wa-ʿāmatātihomu wa-mangəśtomu wa-boʾa wa-ʾarʾayanī kwəlu ḫolaqo kiyāhu
verses.notes: **Uriel writes down everything for Enoch — names, years, rule, the whole count of the stars.** The Enoch-as-celestial-scribe motif — picked up in 3 Enoch (Sefer Hekhalot) where Enoch becomes Metatron the celestial scribe.
